entities.name: PMID:25431127
observations: Phase II single-arm study of sulforaphane-rich broccoli sprout extract in 20 men with recurrent prostate cancer; 200 μmol/day for up to 20 weeks.

Only 1/20 participants achieved the primary endpoint of at least 50% PSA decline; seven had smaller declines. PSA doubling time increased from 6.1 to 9.6 months (p=0.044); no grade 3 adverse events reported.

entities.name: PMID:31155953
observations: Separate randomized placebo-controlled broccoli sprout extract study in 98 men presenting for prostate biopsy; assessed bioavailability and chemoprevention-related biomarkers, not treatment of recurrent prostate cancer.
